en: A black-and-white photograph postcard depicting a forested hill with a tall cylindrical stone tower standing on the summit. The foreground shows an open field, and the hillside is densely covered with coniferous trees. The tower is the only man-made structure visible, creating a striking landmark amid the natural landscape. There is no visible text or annotation on the front of the postcard.
